specName: Generic Work Center — Screen Layer and Preview Host

classification.scopeSignal: three new projects, eleven screens with view models, a card with four variants, a preview host, and a build-time Temp-naming guard

decisions.decision: separate preview application, not an application mode
decisions.why: constitution II and the retired-symbol audit forbid a demo mode in the product
decisions.rejected: a feature key swapping seam implementations inside the app

decisions.decision: one seam interface with a method per data need
decisions.why: expresses every data need without a file per method

decisions.decision: one result type carrying a presentation value
decisions.why: makes exactly-one-of-three impossible to violate and lets the retry control follow the state
decisions.rejected: three booleans on the view model

decisions.decision: one step frame control draws all three presentations
decisions.why: ten pages share the same empty, unavailable and retry surface
decisions.rejected: a merged resource dictionary of data templates

decisions.decision: the Temp boundary is enforced by a source-scanning test
decisions.why: matches the repo existing audits and can name the offending file and token

decisions.decision: work-order comparison drawn by a Temp stand-in inside the preview app
decisions.why: the real card lives in the shipping app project which the preview app cannot reference without dragging in startup and packaging
decisions.rejected: moving the work-order card into a library in this chunk

decisions.decision: a static page-host seam (GenericRequestPageServices) so every screen has a parameterless constructor
decisions.why: Frame.Navigate activates a page by type and cannot pass a view model, and the page-activation audit enforces it
decisions.rejected: leaving the screens constructor-only and exempting them from the audit

decisions.decision: one availability read on the seam for the three screens that read no rows
decisions.why: all ten screens must report the same three presentations without inventing an empty list
decisions.rejected: letting the preview set a view model's presentation directly

plan.summary: Planned three new projects: the flow library with its seam and ten screens, the card library, and a separate preview application.
plan.key_finding: the repository audits every XAML file against a surface inventory and scans the whole tree, so each new view needs an inventory row and must fill its window.

tasks.summary: 35 tasks in six phases: setup of three projects, foundational seam and presenter, ten screens plus the preview host, the cards, the Temp boundary audit, then the inventory and the gates.

implement.summary: Built three projects: the flow library with its seam and ten screens, the card library, and the separate preview application, plus the Temp boundary audit and the inventory rows.

approach: Three new projects sit outside the shipped application: the flow library holds the seam, the view models and the ten screens; the card library holds the generic card and its detail page; and a separate preview application supplies every screen from an in-memory scenario. A source-scanning audit fails the build if any Temp-named artefact reaches the application.

FR-001.title: The flow's views MUST be built as their own projects, separate from the work-order wizard

FR-002.title: The generic card and its detail page MUST be built as their own project

FR-003.title: The preview host MUST be a separate project the shipped application does not reference

FR-004.title: Every step of a generic request MUST exist as a laid-out view

FR-005.title: Each view MUST be bound to a view model and read no database, service or file directly

FR-006.title: Each view MUST render populated, empty and unavailable, with attempt time and retry

FR-007.title: Long values MUST be accommodated without overlap or clipping

FR-008.title: Every screen MUST adapt from the narrowest supported width to a wide monitor

FR-009.title: Every user-visible string MUST come from a resource key and interactive elements carry automation names

FR-010.title: Every data need MUST be expressed as an interface declared outside the application

FR-011.title: The preview host MUST supply those interfaces from in-memory scenarios

FR-012.title: The preview host MUST offer a way to choose a screen, a variant and a scenario

FR-013.title: The preview host MUST NOT connect to or write to any store

FR-014.title: Preview scenarios MUST present the awkward real values

FR-015.title: The generic card MUST draw its own layout and no work-order cells

FR-016.title: The generic card MUST be previewable in its part, dunnage, scrap and die variants

FR-017.title: Generic and work-order cards MUST be viewable in one list and distinguishable

FR-018.title: No generic card MUST draw a blank or placeholder cell

FR-019.title: No runtime switch MAY select preview data and the retired identifiers stay absent

FR-020.title: The shipped application MUST build and run with the preview host absent

FR-021.title: Every artefact standing in for real data MUST begin with Temp in the shape its kind allows

FR-022.title: The preview host's project, assembly and root namespace MUST carry the Temp naming

FR-023.title: A build-time check MUST fail naming the offending artefact

FR-024.title: The check MUST allow the preview project and test code and list other exemptions explicitly

FR-025.title: The check MUST NOT rely on the words the retired-symbol audit forbids

FR-026.title: Removing a Temp artefact MUST require no other edit to keep the build green
